description:
## Finding

`pkix-ac/src/lib.rs:60`:

```rust
/// Issuer name and serial number pair, used to identify a PKC.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct IssuerSerial {
    pub issuer: Name,
    pub serial: OctetString,
}
```

`pkix-ac` is the v0.1.1 stub crate ("planned"). When it gains a real implementation in v0.2 / v0.3, the `IssuerSerial` struct will likely need to track additional RFC 5755 §4.2.2 fields (`AttCertIssuer`'s baseCertificateID has `issuerUID` too).

Adding fields to a non-`#[non_exhaustive]` struct is a breaking change. Mark it now.

## Fix

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
#[non_exhaustive]
pub struct IssuerSerial {
    pub issuer: Name,
    pub serial: OctetString,
}
```

Same applies to `Holder` and any other public struct in pkix-ac that's likely to grow fields.

## Priority

P4 — stub crate, future-proofing. Cheap to do now.
title: P4: pkix-ac IssuerSerial pub struct missing #[non_exhaustive] (stub crate, future-proofing)
